turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Namaste! Main Udaan Finserv ki taraf se Kavya bol rahi hoon, ek AI assistant. Kya main Sneha ji se baat kar rahi hoon?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Sneha ji, aapne personal loan ke liye enquiry ki thi. Kya aap 2 minute baat kar sakti hain?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Haan. Kitne tak ka loan milega aur byaj kitna hoga?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Hamare QuickCash loan mein 50 hazaar se 10 lakh rupaye tak ka loan mil sakta hai. Byaj dar 13 se 24 percent saalana hai, aur aapko kitna rate milega ye aapki credit profile par depend karta hai.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Processing fee loan amount ka 2 percent plus GST hai, jo disbursal ke time kaat li jaati hai.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Approval aapki credit assessment aur document verification par depend karta hai, isliye main approval ki guarantee nahi de sakti. Approval ke baad 24 se 48 ghante mein disbursal ho jata hai.

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Zaroor. Main aapko Aadhaar, PAN, 3 mahine ki bank statement aur income proof ki list WhatsApp par bhej deti hoon.
